title: Soviet psychokinesis experiments on mice in submarines

tellings.quote: But obviously I mean as the Soviets figured out in the 1970s when they were taking mice down in submarines and trying to stop their hearts, you can use the same thing to kill somebody.

plain: In the 1970s, Soviet researchers are said to have taken mice down in submarines and tried to stop their hearts with the mind alone, a test of psychokinesis, the idea that thought can act directly on matter. The philosopher Jason Jorjani mentions this in passing to Michels, without a source, as evidence that the Soviets learned such a power "can be used to kill somebody." If true, it would mean mental powers were studied as a weapon.
